summary: Teams of 2-4 students create a branding package for PixelPlay Gaming Café, including a logo with tagline or mission statement and at least three promotional items (such as posters, social media ads, or merchandise). The project must be submitted as a ZIP file with required forms and documentation, and teams present their work to judges at the national competition. Entries are judged on technical design and presentation skills.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than ten (10) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
submission_requirements: All graphics must be computer generated
It is recommended designs be at least 300 dpi
Materials must follow the organization’s BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
The team is responsible for securing a signed BPA Release Form(s) from any person, including themselves, whose image or work is used in the project
The contestant is responsible for citing all sources, including themselves, on the Works Cited page for any work used on the project
Projects must be viewable on Windows and Mac platforms
Set the access level of your project to one of BPA’s recommended settings
See the Cloud Sharing Guidelines for additional information
deadlines: National Deadline: April 1, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
what_to_bring: Optional - Students may use one single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for their presentation
competencies: Integrate color theory, typography, and design principles & elements—including hierarchy, spacing, and grid systems—to create visually compelling, readable, and brand-consistent designs across digital and print media

Apply audience analysis and user-centered design principles & elements to develop and present design concepts persuasively, using visual storytelling and data-driven rationale to support thematic choices and engagement for a defined target audience

Create original artwork and utilize advanced technical skills with industry-standard software to edit, manipulate, and optimize graphics, artwork, and images for diverse design applications, ensuring quality and efficiency
Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams, utilizing project management and communication tools to achieve shared objectives and deliver high-quality outcomes

rubric.criterion: Team followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy.

The following items have been saved as PDFs and bundled together in a single ZIP file.
1. Logo
2. Three (3) promotional items
3. Works Cited (formatted in accordance with the Style & Reference Manual )
4. BPA Release Form(s)
5. AI Usage and Documentation Form

rubric.description: Design shows deep understanding of audience with highly effective visual strategies.
Products showcase bold, original ideas and inventive execution.
Design is visually captivating with strong use of aesthetic principles.
Designs show consistent branding with individualized, creative variation.
All products feature compelling focal points that enhance viewer engagement.
Composition demonstrates elegant harmony, creating a polished and professional feel.
Fonts and color palettes are expertly chosen to elevate overall impact.
Whitespace is strategically used to enhance flow, hierarchy, and aesthetic value.
Strategic placement and emphasis guide viewer through the design, using advanced compositional techniques.

rubric.criterion: Team followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Team maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
Presentation content flows adequately, and each team member's role is clear and integrated into the presentation. Transitions between speakers and/or points are smooth.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges' questions.
At least two original team members were present during the presentation.
Setup lasted no longer than three (3) minutes, and the presentation lasted no more than ten (10) minutes.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the team within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, contestants may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
No materials may be left with the judges
Only the team captain should complete the submission
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this judged team event
A team will consist of 2-4 contestants
Teams must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
